findings.text: non-blocking: the live-store row states "27 would be refused, naming 27 sections", while logs/live-store-pass.log lists 27 plans naming 49 sections across 5 projects, so the recorded blast radius roughly halves the section count and reports plans and sections as one number.

non-blocking: the file is outside the node's declared write paths, which list only reckon/_store.py and tests/test_a_plan_does_not_close_over_an_unlanded_section.py; plan §6 permits an optional per-node fragment but the dispatch declared no path for it.

non-blocking: `ledger.runs` is called once per unanswered section from the comprehension at reckon/_store.py:5094-5099, so a close over a plan carrying many unfurnished sections reloads the whole ledger once per section; the node's own live pass had to wrap it with a cache (live_store_pass.py:cached_runs) for the same reason.

non-blocking: when the state carries no `project` or `slug` the run-record branch returns False silently, so a caller that reaches the guard with a state read outside `_store.read_plan` refuses a section whose run record exists; the docstring at reckon/_store.py:5074-5078 documents only the missing-document degrade.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against dffc9bccd5151443dbbb2d09f29ba30315298a30; 28211e786d1bdb64fad7207d8fc6c7398d0b78ff adds the guard, its three helpers and 180 lines of tests, and 37cb0d686e10541a7b1ecfe55d4a04a884c726cb adds the 32-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a new test file with four named cases, two negative controls and a live-store count, and tests/test_a_plan_does_not_close_over_an_unlanded_section.py carries five cases covering them; both negative-control logs at logs/negative-control-guard-removed.log and logs/negative-control-ignores-done-when.log are red with `EXIT=1`, and logs/live-store-pass.log records 27 refusals over 172 open plans.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to refuse a close over a done section with no landing; reckon/_store.py:5058 defines `_require_every_landed_section_answered` and reckon/_store.py:5259 registers it in the one terminal guard list, where it refuses a transition into a terminal status and names each unfurnished section.
item_verdicts.manifest: the manifest at runs/r-20261115T085732662020-alro-s4/manifest.md states 79 passed at head and 74 at base with no added failure, both negative controls red, and a live-store count; the arm figures reconcile with logs/after-arm.log (`79 passed`, `EXIT=0`) and logs/base-arm.log (`74 passed`, `EXIT=0`), while its artifacts line misstates the live-store blast radius.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node's declared write paths are reckon/_store.py and tests/test_a_plan_does_not_close_over_an_unlanded_section.py; the diff touches exactly those two plus docs/evidence/fragments/a-landing-is-recorded-once/alro-s4.html, which the declared scope does not list.

justifications.durability: each assertion in tests/test_a_plan_does_not_close_over_an_unlanded_section.py:123-180 reddens under a mutation recorded in logs/negative-control-*.log, and none compares a value against a value the test itself passed in.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_plan_does_not_close_over_an_unlanded_section.py reruns 5 passed at the head revision and both negative-control logs carry `EXIT=1`, but the recorded live-store figure at docs/evidence/fragments/a-landing-is-recorded-once/alro-s4.html:29 understates the section count.
justifications.fit: reckon/_store.py:5058 follows the `_require_*` guard family and the docstring style of its neighbours at reckon/_store.py:5000, and no added name carries a plan or stage label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_store.py:5259 fires `_require_every_landed_section_answered` only on a transition into a terminal status, which is the refusal the goal states.
justifications.reuse: reckon/_store.py:5139-5155 reuses `_plan_html._closing_comment`, `section_prose`, `section_id_candidates`, `_done_when_paragraph` and `ledger.runs`; a search over reckon/ found no other owner of "does this section hold a landing", and the one new helper at reckon/_store.py:5111 is a thin mapping over the existing reader.
justifications.scope_discipline: reckon/_store.py:5058-5165 and the new test file are inside the declared paths, and docs/evidence/fragments/a-landing-is-recorded-once/alro-s4.html:1 is an added file outside them.
